newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to drift near the 4,800 region.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to drift near the 4,800 region.

text.p: The FTSE 100 will drift lower on Monday to test the 4,800 support level before edging higher, technical analysts said.
Although it managed to make record highs last week, it may not seem determined to continue that rally and appears uncomfortable with the idea of further strong gains, they added.

Following that sharp rise, a likely course for the market would now be for it to find a floor by testing support levels and nervous activity by investors could make it bounce uneasily near the 4,800 region.
By 0733 GMT, the FTSE was up 6.1 at 4,818.9.
